tools.name: search_cars
tools.description: Free-text search across 103,372 vehicle variants, 120 brands, 20 languages. Returns candidate variant_ids to pass to get_specs/get_images/compare_variants. Each result carries generation_id and production years so same-named variants from different generations can be told apart. Without a key — or w

tools.name: get_specs
tools.description: Full localized specs for one vehicle variant, in any of 20 languages — 224 spec types covering engine & fuel, performance, EV/hybrid, safety, comfort & interior, exterior, chassis, dimensions & weights, consumption (WLTP/NEDC). Each spec carries a confidence score; the response carries last_synced_a

tools.name: compare_variants
tools.description: Side-by-side localized specs for 2-4 vehicle variants.

tools.name: list_generations
tools.description: Generations/facelifts of a model, with production years.

tools.name: filter_cars
tools.description: Structured catalog filter: fuel type, body type, drive layout, power/price range, model year, EV-only.

tools.name: get_images
tools.description: Image URLs (own CDN, no attribution burden) for a vehicle variant.

tools.name: search_catalogue
tools.description: Search all 103,372 variants (not only the 40-car demo). Returns opaque variant_ids for get_specs_full. Paid per call with x402 (USDC) — $0.005.

tools.name: get_specs_full
tools.description: Full localized specs for ANY variant in the catalogue, in 20 languages. Paid per call with x402 (USDC) — $0.05. Not charged when the id is unknown.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
